translations.web: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.
translations.bsb: As drought and heat consume the melting snow, so Sheol steals those who have sinned.
translations.kjv: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.
